distinguishing_scenario: A backend standard switches from a dash list to paths: ["backend/**/*.cs"]: same intended glob, the checker reports it outside the backend scope territory.
facet_text: The checker parses an inline flow list (paths: ["..."]) as a single literal glob string; for non-common scopes it then fails the scope-territory check, while for the common scope it passes unchecked as one glob.
rationale: Verified: parseFrontmatter stores '["backend/**/*.cs"]' as a string (quote stripping only touches leading/trailing quote characters), [].concat wraps it as one glob, and globInScope('["backend...', 'backend') fails the backend/ prefix test. FG-K0-8ab601c125 requires non-empty paths inside the scope territory without the representation boundary. Resolves the Codex uncertainty as a checker-boundary facet (consistent with the paths facets of the other candidates); whether the host accepts inline lists is not verified.
